question: What fractional increments are specified for the progressive measurements described?
premises: The measure sapādaṃ specifies an addition of one quarter.
The measure sārdhamaṣṭāṃśādhikaṃ specifies an addition of a half plus an eighth.
The measure pādatrayādikam specifies a starting point of three quarters and similar increments.
inference: The prescribed measurements advance through specified fractional increments including a quarter, a half plus an eighth, and three quarters onward.
uncertainties: The exact base unit to which these fractional increments are applied is carried over from the preceding verses.
plain_english: The measurements include an additional quarter, an additional half plus an eighth, and three quarters and so on.
